summary.name: WiKiss
summary.one_liner: WiKiss is a simple, easy-to-install wiki written in PHP that needs only PHP to run and is distributed under the GPLv2 license.
use_cases: Run a small team or personal wiki
Host a wiki on a basic PHP web server
Keep page revision history with diffs
Protect a wiki with a password
summary.what_it_does: WiKiss is a wiki that requires only PHP to be installed and can be set up in about two minutes, according to the page. It offers a simplified markup syntax, history management with differences between versions, and password protection. It also includes an automatic table of contents, built-in search, and extension through plugins such as table management and RSS feed generation. The page says it outputs XHTML 1.0 Transitional and can be easily themed. It is a derivative of TigerWiki, whose development has stopped.
notable: Needs only PHP and installs/configures in about two minutes
Derived from TigerWiki, whose development has stopped
Plugin system (tables, RSS feed generation) and easy theming
Name comes from Wiki + KISS (Keep It Short and Simple)
caveats: Current stable version listed on the page is 0.3 (Bada Bing), last page edit dated 2008
Page is in French; documentation and support are via mailing lists and FAQ
